newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Privredna Banka top gainer.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Privredna Banka top gainer.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in buoyant trade on Thursday, with shares in troubled Privredna Banka going for grabs.
* Ten of 17 issues that traded rose, six fell and one was flat. Volume almost three times higher at 26,118 shares, turnover also rose to 13.1 million kuna.
* Top gainer Privredna Banka Zagreb jumped 110 to 260 kuna, selling 7,055 shares.
* Biggest decliner shipper Jadroplov lost 60 kuna to 190, with 450 units sold in a first deal since last November.
* Most active food processor Podravka gained five kuna to 355 on volume of 7,396 shares.
